newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: POSCO seen meeting '97 profit target.
newsitem.headline: POSCO seen meeting '97 profit target.

text.p: South Korea's largest steelmaker Pohang Iron and Steel Co (POSCO) would achieve an earlier earnings target for calendar 1997, a company official said on Monday.
Oh Dong-ho, an accounting official, said POSCO's net profit would hit an historic high of 878.7 billion won on turnover of 9.08 trillion this year.
POSCO's after-tax profit was 623.96 billion won on 8.45 trillion in sales last year.
"An increase in sales prices in the first half and sharply reduced depreciation will contribute to the surge," Oh said.
